CHIEF COMPLAINT
Lower back pain

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Patient is a male presenting with left-sided lower back pain. He reports a history of back surgery in November 2020 for a microdiscectomy due to a herniated disk that had wrapped around the spinal thecal sac. He initially presented with severe nerve pain radiating down his leg and was treated with high-dose gabapentin, which was difficult to discontinue. Currently experiencing left-sided lower back pain that varies day to day, sometimes affecting the right side as well. Pain is generally located around the surgical site (L5 region). Pain is exacerbated by bending over and occurs randomly during weightbearing activities. Stretching, as recommended by his significant other, provides relief. He has tried ibuprofen 800 mg daily for pain management. Denies current radiating nerve pain down legs.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
No radiating leg pain. No other acute complaints reported.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Back surgery with microdiscectomy for herniated intervertebral disk (November 2020)

MEDICATIONS
Ibuprofen 800 mg daily

ALLERGIES
Not documented

FAMILY HISTORY
Not documented

SOCIAL HISTORY
Not documented

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
General: Patient able to ambulate
Back: Pain with weightbearing. Pain with palpation to left side at L5 region. No pain with palpation to right side. No pain with forward flexion. No pain with extension. Normal range of motion. Neurological exam: Dorsiflexion intact bilaterally with normal strength. No pain with lower extremity strength testing.

RESULTS
X-ray of spine: No fractures. Surgical hardware intact with evidence of proper healing from previous surgery. No acute findings.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
1. Left lower back pain, post-microdiscectomy with suspected muscle strain and spinal misalignment. Will prescribe physical therapy at VA facility. Prescribed meloxicam instead of current ibuprofen for improved pain management. Referral to pain management for further evaluation and discussion regarding non-narcotic pain management strategies. Also prescribed demerol for pain control.
